---
title: "About"
---

I am Faran Abbas, a graduate student in World Economy at Shandong University. You can view my work on [GitHub](https://github.com/faranabbas-repo) or contact me at [faranabbas@hotmail.com](mailto:faranabbas@hotmail.com).

This project studies fiscal balance, trade openness, and GDP across SAARC countries from 2000 to 2024 using World Bank World Development Indicators. It is a regional macroeconomic analysis focused on how policy-related indicators differ across South Asian economies. You can view the repository [here](https://github.com/faranabbas-repo/fiscal-trade-gdp).

This project was developed as part of [Kane's Data Science Bootcamp](https://bootcamp.davidkane.info/).
